title: Ten and Oh, and the Power Ratings Still Have Peyton Fifth
dek: Peyton beats John to reach 10–0, Chris & Miguel come back from 19% against Nathan, and Mack and Mike Barry combine for the 5th highest-scoring game in league history.

title: 198.5 Points, and the 9–0 Team Is Now No. 2

title: Eight and Oh, and Still Not Quite Believable
